mismatches.title: SBI FD interest ₹50L — not in ledger
mismatches.description: SBI reported ₹50,00,000 FD interest to the Income Tax Department via AIS. This income is not reflected in your tax ledger for FY 2025-26.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Add to income under 'Income from Other Sources'. Advance tax may apply for Q4.

mismatches.title: Zerodha STCG ₹3.2L — class mismatch
mismatches.description: Short-term capital gains from Zerodha equity sales reported in AIS as ₹3,20,000 but filed under LTCG in draft return.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Reclassify as STCG under Section 111A. Tax rate: 20% (post July 2024).

mismatches.title: TDS ₹1.8L on FD — not claimed in return
mismatches.description: TDS of ₹1,80,000 deducted by ICICI Bank on FD interest appears in 26AS but is not claimed in ITR draft.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Claim TDS credit under Schedule TDS. Verify Form 16A matches 26AS entry.

mismatches.title: US brokerage account — Schedule FA missing
mismatches.description: Foreign equity holdings via Interactive Brokers reported in AIS. Schedule FA (Foreign Assets) not included in draft ITR.
mismatches.suggested_fix: File Schedule FA with account details, peak balance, and closing balance. Black Money Act penalties apply for non-disclosure.

mismatches.title: MF redemption reported twice in AIS
mismatches.description: HDFC MF redemption of ₹12,50,000 appears in AIS under both HDFC AMC and CAMS aggregator entries.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Report once in ITR. Attach reconciliation note for potential scrutiny.

mismatches.title: Schedule AL — assets not fully disclosed
mismatches.description: Income exceeds ₹1 Cr threshold. Schedule AL requires disclosure of all immovable property and financial assets. Jaipur commercial property missing.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Add Jaipur commercial property to Schedule AL. Include purchase date, cost, and address.
